source.innerPages: Inherit tokens through shadcn primitives under src/components/ui/; not individually restyled.

chalk-dim.note: Chalk at 0.8 alpha; raised from lower alpha in the finish fix pass for legibility.

display.purpose: Wordmark placeholder: the sign (Olive Back, upright, no shadow, clamp(3rem, 7.5vw, 4.75rem)), the rail (1.9rem, -2deg, 1px Rail Deep shadow), footer and mobile sheet (1.875rem). Mr Dafoe stands in until lettering is commissioned.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the counter question. Zilla Slab 700, sentence case, -0.01em, 1.05.

title.purpose: Shelf region labels (0.875rem) and footer column labels (0.76rem): Zilla Slab 600, uppercase, 0.16em. The board title is the same face uppercase at 0.14em, chalk-roughened.

body.purpose: All paragraphs in Jost 400 at 0.875rem; secondary copy in Muted Foreground bounded to max-w-prose.

label.purpose: Jost 600 uppercase: sign line (0.26em), counter labels (0.72rem, 0.16em, Dirt), board region labels (0.72rem, 0.14em, Chalk Dim), badge names (0.1em, clamp(0.6875rem, 6cqi, 0.78rem)), primary button (0.95rem, 0.12em). Rail nav is Jost 500 at 0.8rem, 0.14em.

live.purpose: Courier Prime, tabular numerals, only for measured or entered numbers and dates: board date, temperatures, offsets, reading times, the date input.

themeFonts.--font-mono: "Courier Prime", "Courier Prime Fallback", ui-monospace, "Courier New", monospace
themeFonts.--font-script: "Mr Dafoe", "Mr Dafoe Fallback", "Brush Script MT", cursive

fontLoading.note: globals.css names the families literally; the next/font variables are registered on <html> but not read by the theme. layout.tsx still binds Zilla Slab and Mr Dafoe to consts named alfa and yellowtail.

shadows.name: hung-sign
shadows.purpose: The enamel sign; the insets are its 1px Ink pinstripe.

shadows.name: counter-pad
shadows.purpose: The order card resting on the counter.

shadows.name: wall-card
shadows.purpose: Fly cards and the evidence legend.

shadows.name: board
shadows.purpose: The chalkboard recessed in its 8px Rail frame.

shadows.name: patch-rest
shadows.purpose: River badge at rest (filter, on the SVG).

shadows.name: patch-lift
shadows.purpose: River badge on hover and focus, with translateY(-3px) rotate(-1deg).

shadows.name: button
shadows.purpose: Primary submit at rest; hover 0 14px 22px -10px / 0.6; active 0 6px 12px -8px / 0.5; disabled 0 6px 12px -8px / 0.4.

shadows.name: rail
shadows.purpose: Header trim onto the wall; the footer mirrors it upward (0 -6px 14px -8px).

shadows.name: ledge
shadows.purpose: The 12px shelf under each badge region.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Every lift, press, and chalk draw-on.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: Primary button transform, shadow, and color.

motion.name: chalk-in
motion.value: 620ms ease-spring both; delay calc(var(--i) * 70ms); from { opacity: 0; clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0) } to { opacity: 1; clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0) }
motion.purpose: Board rows draw on once inside .board-reveal[data-reveal="in"]; rows visible by default; reduced motion disables it.

motion.name: drift-plate
motion.value: translate3d(-50%, 0, 0) to translate3d(-50%, -6%, 0); animation-timeline: scroll(root); animation-range: 0 120vh
motion.purpose: Engraved plate parallax; requires animation-timeline support and no-preference motion.

motion.name: drift-near
motion.value: translate3d(0, 0, 0) to translate3d(0, -2.5rem, 0); animation-timeline: scroll(root); animation-range: 0 120vh
motion.purpose: Near plane (sign, board) parallax; the front card never moves.

breakpoints.name: board-two-col
breakpoints.purpose: Water readings go to two columns.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Badge row leaves snap-scroll for a 3-col grid; shelf head splits 1fr/380px with the map; counter foot key goes 3-col.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Counter card and board sit side by side 7fr/5fr; badges 5-col; fly cards 4-col.

breakpoints.name: container
breakpoints.purpose: max-w-6xl content width with 1rem side padding.

planes.name: plane-plate
planes.note: plane-plate-bottom variant pins a plate to the bottom edge.

planes.name: wall-grain
planes.note: SVG fractalNoise tile 240px over a 164px shiplap repeat; the only texture layer on the wall.

stateVocabulary.scope: Hatch board only; Jost 500 at 0.95rem, line-height 1.2, filter url(#chalk-rough).

approaching.mark: hand-dashed box: 1.6px dashed chalk-dim, inset -3px -4px, radius 3px

peak.mark: rough rose fill: trout-band, inset -1px -2px, radius 3px; weight 600; padding-inline 0.45rem

badgeShapes.manner: Campbell Outfitters: solid fill, ink edge, two solid inset keylines, small mark at top, caps name, script sub-line.
badgeShapes.edge: stroke 2, round joins; Ink by default, the text color on cream fills
badgeShapes.mark: translate(80 18), drawn in the badge text color
badgeShapes.text: container-type inline-size; padding 15cqi 8cqi 5cqi; name clamp(0.6875rem, 6cqi, 0.78rem) Jost 600 caps 0.1em; sub clamp(0.85rem, 8cqi, 1.1rem) Mr Dafoe, opacity 0.95
badgeShapes.active: stroke trout-band, width 5; shape and fill unchanged

plates.technique: currentColor hairline strokes (0.55 to 2.2 units) with fine hatched <pattern> fills; one ink, no second hue, no gradient

michiganMap.placement: beside the shelf title, 16rem on phones, 380px column at sm; five-swatch region key beneath
michiganMap.dots: r 1.5, stroke Ink 0.3, colored by region; hover r 2.6 with 0.6 trout-band stroke; each dot links to its river page
michiganMap.a11y: role=img with aria-label; dots are links with aria-label

pineStand.placement: top of the footer rail, Cream at 50% opacity

logo.note: Owner's full-color leaping rainbow trout, transparent; 260px on the sign, 140px compact and in the footer. The only full-color image on the shell; not a placeholder.

shadcnMapping.note: Inner pages inherit through these; radius scale sm 0.3rem, md 0.4rem, lg 0.5rem, xl 0.7rem, 2xl 0.9rem, 3xl 1.1rem, 4xl 1.3rem.

nightVariant.status: defined, not shipped; no toggle exposed; the scene is daylight

How much to trust each line

What should be on the end of my line?

Four questions. The answer is a ranked box for that river on that date, with the reasons.

How much to trust the answerS Scientific. A Angler consensus. I Inferred.

narrative.overview:
The site is the back wall of a Michigan fly shop, and the wall works as an instrument rather than a backdrop. Every surface is a material that would hang there: cream painted shiplap for the page, a dark green chalkboard for anything live, an enamel sign over the counter carrying the owner's leaping rainbow trout, engraved plates in one dirt-brown ink for the river bend, the Michigan map and the pine stand, outfitter patches for the rivers, dirt-brown wood rails for the header and footer, and a pencil-ruled counter pad for the order form. The palette is the rainbow trout laid on those materials: olive back, rose lateral band, cream belly, copper fin, gill red, lake steel, ink black for type and edges.

The register is a field guide, not a souvenir shop. Planks are faint, the grain is light, the engraving sits at low contrast behind the first viewport, and nothing repeats as a pattern. Four depth planes stack in a fixed order (engraved plate, shiplap, board and badges, counter card); the plate and the near plane drift on scroll and the front card holds still. Nothing is left unpainted on any viewport; the wall runs edge to edge under everything, including the rails. Depth is physical: hard Ink borders at 1.5 to 2px, real downward shadows under things that hang, inset shadows on things that recess. Type is a refined slab for the section titles and small woodtype labels, a sign-painter script standing in for a commissioned wordmark, a geometric sans for every badge, label, chip, sign line and paragraph, and a typewriter mono that appears only where a number is live.

Confirmed rejections from the build: no photographic river hero; no white page with badges scattered as decoration; no chalkboard styled as a menu; no repeating pattern on any surface (the screen-printed wallpaper, the woodcut header and the stitched badge edges of the first pass were removed as childish); no kicker or eyebrow above any heading (the small woodtype-caps region labels on the shelf are level-three headings in their own right, not eyebrows over a larger title).
keyCharacteristics: Trout palette on shop materials; the page background is faint painted shiplap, never flat white and never a pattern.
Four named depth planes with scroll parallax on the rear planes only.
One reserved live color (chalk-yellow mono) that appears only on the chalkboard's date, offsets and gauge readings.
A strict four-state chalk vocabulary for hatch timing, used only on the board.
River badges follow the Campbell Outfitters manner, one silhouette, one fill and one mark per DNR fishing-report region, under a shared Ink edge and two solid keylines.
Supporting illustration is engraved SVG line art in one ink, authored as slots for commissioned art; the mark itself is the owner's full-color logo file.
Inner pages inherit these tokens through shadcn primitives and have not been individually restyled yet.

rules.name: The Reserved Live Color Rule
rules.body: `live` (chalk-yellow mono) appears only on the chalkboard and only on numbers and dates that came from a live source today: the date line, water temperatures, gauge reading times, region offsets. It is never used as a text color anywhere else, and the board never sets a static word in it.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Rose Band is the only warm accent on a screen. It marks peak on the board, the current page on the rail, selection, the active badge and the hovered map dot. It is not used for decoration, backgrounds, or a second call to action.

rules.name: The Ink Border Rule
rules.body: Anything that hangs on the wall or sits on the counter is outlined in Ink (1.5px on the counter card, 2px on cards, buttons and the sign, 2 SVG units on badges). Ghost or tonal borders belong only to small tags and the shadcn inner-page primitives.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Engraved illustration is drawn in a single color, Dirt, at hairline stroke weights with hatched fills; it never takes a second hue, a gradient or a photograph. The only full-color image on the shell is the owner's trout logo.

rules.name: The Slab Titles Only Rule
rules.body: Zilla Slab appears at two settings, bold sentence-case titles and semibold tracked caps labels; it never sets body copy, badges, buttons or the sign line, all of which belong to Jost.

rules.name: The Mono Means Live Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is reserved for numbers and dates that were measured or entered, not for labels, code, or decoration. If it is set in mono, a reader may trust it is a real reading.

rules.name: The Badge Type Scales With The Badge Rule
rules.body: Badge lettering is sized in container-query units (name `clamp(0.6875rem, 6cqi, 0.78rem)`, script sub-line `clamp(0.85rem, 8cqi, 1.1rem)`, text inset `15cqi 8cqi 5cqi`) so the mark and the lower keyline are cleared at every badge width.

rules.name: The Hung Object Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the object is physically on the wall: it is offset downward, blurred, warm grey, and paired with a hard Ink border. Hard offset shadows without blur are not used; the badge's 3px contact drop is the patch's own thickness, under a blurred cast.

rules.name: The Front Plane Holds Still Rule
rules.body: Only the engraved plate and the near plane move on scroll; the counter card and the rails never do.

rules.name: The Badge Shape Per Region Rule
rules.body: A river badge's outline, fill, lettering color and mark are decided by its region and nothing else: U.P. shield in Lake Steel, Northwest arch in Cream with Olive lettering and edge, Northeast plate in Olive Back, Southwest hexagon in Copper Fin, Southeast oval in Cream with Copper lettering and edge. All five share the same 2:1 ratio, the ink-colored edge, two solid keylines, a caps name and a script sub-line, so the shelf reads as one set. An active badge thickens its edge to 5 units and turns it Rose Band; it does not change shape or fill.

rules.name: The State Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Hatch timing on the board is spoken in exactly four chalk states, each one treatment, all in Jost 500 at 0.95rem on the roughened filter: approaching is Chalk Dim inside a hand-dashed 1.6px box; hatching is Chalk with a 3px chalk underline; peak is Ink on a rough Rose Band fill at 600 weight with 0.45rem side padding; finished is Chalk Dim at 85% struck through by one 2.5px stroke rotated -2deg. No other color, icon, or weight signals state, and the vocabulary is used only on the board.

dos: Do paint every viewport with the wall (`.wall` with its faint plank repeat and 10% grain); a new page that shows flat `--background` alone has left the world.
Do outline hung and counter objects in Ink (1.5 to 2px cards and buttons, 2px sign) and give them a downward warm-grey shadow keyed to `oklch(0.2 0.02 60)`.
Do set section titles in Zilla Slab 700 sentence case, and small woodtype labels in Zilla Slab 600 uppercase with 0.16em tracking; set every other word, including the sign line and badges, in Jost.
Do reserve Courier Prime and the `live` color for measured numbers and dates on the board, and keep the four chalk states as the only hatch-timing language.
Do give each DNR region's river badge its own silhouette, fill and mark from the fixed table, all on the shared Ink edge with two solid keylines, and size badge type in container units.
Do draw supporting illustration as engraved line art in Dirt (hairline strokes, hatched fills, one ink) sized as a slot for commissioned art; use the owner's trout logo file for the mark.
Do put focus in Copper Fin (3px outline, 2px offset) and the current nav item in a Rose Band tab.
Do keep parallax on the rear planes only and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; content must be complete with motion off.
donts: Don't use a photograph as a page hero or a full-bleed background; imagery is reference photos inside cards, insect thumbnails, the engraved plates, and the logo.
Don't lay a repeating pattern on any surface; the shiplap seam and the ruled card are material, a tiled motif is not.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow line above a heading. The shelf's region labels are level-three headings with their own offset tag; do not add a smaller line over a title anywhere else.
Don't use `live` chalk-yellow, Courier Prime, or any chalk state off the board.
Don't introduce a second accent; Rose Band is the only warm highlight, and Copper Fin belongs to focus, hover, and the Southwest and Southeast badges.
Don't set body copy, buttons or the sign line in Zilla Slab, and don't set the slab lighter than 500 (only 500, 600 and 700 are loaded).
Don't flatten badges into rectangles, recolor them by river, or bring back a dashed stitch edge; shape, fill and mark are decided by region and the edge is solid.
Don't treat the Night variant as a theme option; it is a token mapping held in reserve, not a shipped scene.
narrative.innerPages: Inner pages currently inherit these tokens through the shadcn primitives (`Button`, `Card`, `Input`, `Select`, `Badge`, `Tabs`, and the rest under `src/components/ui/`) and have not been individually restyled to the wall. Their radii, ring borders, and heights are shadcn defaults mapped onto the palette; when an inner page is brought into the world it should adopt the wall, the Ink border rule, and the shadow vocabulary above.
narrative.notCanonized: the S/A/I `EvidenceBadge` colors S and A with Tailwind `emerald` and `amber` rather than trout tokens (pre-existing, shared with inner pages); the Northwest map dot and its key swatch use a literal moss green (`oklch(0.56 0.08 118)`) that has no token and does not match the Northwest badge's cream fill, and the Southeast dot uses Gill Red where the Southeast badge uses Copper; the wordmark is a Google Fonts script standing in for a commissioned mark and the plates are placeholders for commissioned art.
narrative.futureHeadroom: a chalk hand for the board title, thread texture on badges, wood grain on shiplap and rails, enamel wear or sheen on the sign.
